scope: Replacement work-lifecycle decision, non-running admission reference kernel, and checkpoint observation endpoint

activation.admission_kernel: not imported by the live server; no tasks enrolled or dispatched
activation.shared_workflow_adapter: not installed or qualified by this change
activation.checkpoint_reporting: deployed backend-only; live original-thread checkpoint returned observationOnly=true, admission=none, existing recovery state cancelled

admission_cases: Accepted unit and event identity deduplication
48 simulated waiting hours and restart without model dispatch
Independent concurrent OS processes sharing one SQLite capacity slot
One active owner per task and thread
Unmanaged runtime activity, incomplete inventory and stale snapshots consume or deny capacity
Lost acknowledgment and owner restart retain uncertainty rather than replaying
Model turn completion differs from acceptance of the requested result
Early producer events are retained; one dependency generation cannot wake work twice
Cancellation and late native acceptance remain fenced until exact settlement
Unreconciled external effects retain the admission fence after a native terminal event
http_cases: Current checkpoint accepted without continuation enrollment
Checkpoint does not revive a cancelled recovery record
No turn/start or turn/steer caused by checkpoint submission
validation.live_reporting: Existing original-thread checkpoint accepted without changing cancelled recovery state; no native daemon restart or model dispatch

limitations: Fixtures prove admission and storage semantics, not end-to-end backup correctness
Trusted producer/result/source parameters require authenticated versioned adapters; they are not self-authenticating
Native parent delegation and child spawning outside a common gate remain outside enforcement
No new model, permissions, account spending, native goals or token budget configured
No new production worker, app task grant, phone installation or broad runtime restart
Shared Temporal service currently qualifies narrow operations; arbitrary Codex work is not claimed supported
